review_text: Two weeks with this phone and I'm happy with it. I leave for work at 8 with a full charge and usually have around 30% left at bedtime, mostly calls, maps and music. Photos of my kids in the park came out really sharp. Switching between apps is quick too. Paid ₹24,999 and it feels like money well spent.

Having to charge twice a day is getting annoying. Took it off the charger at 7 am and it was down to 18% before lunch. Just WhatsApp, calls and a little browsing on office Wi-Fi, no gaming. Thought it would settle down after setup but it's still the same after three weeks.

Daylight shots look lovely, especially landscapes. Indoors it is a different story. Faces look too smooth and pictures of my dog come out blurry unless he sits perfectly still. Night mode makes the scene brighter but loses a lot of detail. Fine for holiday photos outside, less useful for family pictures at home.

Watching movies on this is a treat. Blacks look properly black and subtitles are easy to read even when I'm sitting near a window. Scrolling looks smooth as well. The blue back looks really nice and doesn't collect many fingerprints. Only complaint is the flat edges dig into my palm during long video calls.

Bought it mainly for BGMI. The first match runs well, then after about 20 minutes it gets warm and starts dropping frames during fights. Lowering the graphics helps a little, but I expected better. Normal stuff like UPI and opening Instagram is quick. Wouldn't recommend it for long gaming sessions.

₹24,999 mein mujhe sahi deal lagi. Office apps aur video calls smoothly chal rahe hain, abhi tak hang nahi hua. Camera din mein achha hai, raat ko average. Flagship jaisi photos expect mat karo. Mere daily use ke liye kaafi hai.

The back panel on my unit clicks when I press near the bottom and the volume button rattles. Only been using it for six days, no drops or rough use. It looks premium from a distance but the assembly feels cheap in the hand. I've asked for a replacement because this is not acceptable at this price.
Excellent phone. Very happy with the purchase!

Received today. Got the 8GB/128GB version. The box mentions a 5000 mAh battery and a 50 MP main camera. Haven't transferred my data or tried taking photos yet. Will update the review after a week of use.

Six weeks in, it's an okay phone with a few compromises. The screen is excellent for reading and videos. It survived a fall from my desk without a crack, which was a relief, but it's bulky and uncomfortable in my jeans pocket. Battery lasts until evening on normal days; using navigation means topping up before the journey home. For ₹24,999 I expected a little more.

Indoors the screen looks nice, but outside at noon I can barely read my navigation directions. Tried auto brightness and then pushed the slider all the way up. Still ended up shading it with my hand at every turn. I spend a lot of time outdoors, so this is a pretty big letdown for me.

Finally a phone I don't have to plug in every night! I'm a light user, mostly calls and messages, and a full charge comfortably gets me through a day and a half. A quick top-up while I have breakfast is usually enough before leaving. Very pleased with the battery.

Feels solid. The buttons have a proper click and nothing creaks when I grip it. Been carrying it without a case for a month and the frame finish still looks fine. Was worried it would feel flimsy at this price, but the construction has been reassuring so far.

At ₹24,999 this is just okay value. Nothing is seriously wrong with it, but my previous ₹17,000 phone handled my daily routine about as well. I don't feel like the extra money bought me much. Would have been happier paying around 20k.

Rear camera is really good for food pictures and close-ups of flowers. Colours look natural instead of being boosted too much. Selfies are another matter: my skin looks like wax even after turning the beauty option off. Giving four stars because I mainly use the rear camera, but the front one needs work.

The phone has 8GB RAM but keeps reloading my work apps. I open a PDF, switch to mail to check something, and when I return the document jumps back to the first page. Happens several times a day. WhatsApp and basic browsing are fast enough. Multitasking is the part that's driving me mad.

Dekhne mein phone achha hai, lekin camera ka bada sa bump irritating hai. Table pe rakh ke type karo toh hilta rehta hai. Ek haath se use karna bhi mushkil lag raha hai, kaafi wide hai. Photo quality abhi check nahi ki, yeh complaint sirf shape aur handling ki hai.

Delivery was four days late and the courier kept marking me unavailable even though I was home. Outer box was crushed too. Haven't switched the phone on yet. This one star is for the delivery experience.

Speakers are loud enough for calls but music sounds thin, with almost no bass. At full volume there's a harsh buzzing on some songs. With my headphones it's fine. If you watch videos without earphones a lot, the sound might disappoint you.

Updating after a month. During the first week the phone occasionally froze when opening the recent-apps screen, but the latest update fixed that and it now feels smooth. The screen is lovely for reading comics. Battery is acceptable rather than amazing: I get through a workday with about 10% left. Photos of moving people still blur indoors, so I wouldn't buy it mainly for the camera.

Took this on a weekend trip instead of carrying my old camera. Mountain shots have plenty of detail and the portrait photos separated hair from the background surprisingly well. Videos while walking were steady enough to share straight away. The screen was also bright enough to check my shots outdoors. Really happy with what I got for ₹24,999.
Not slow at all. Apps open straight away. Battery isn't bad either, usually lasts until bedtime. Haven't tried the camera yet.

A thin green line appeared down the middle of the display on the eighth day. It stays there on every app and even on the startup logo. Restarting did nothing. No drops or water exposure. Watching anything with that line across it is awful, and now I have to take a new phone to the service centre.

Battery backup mast hai. Subah charge karta hu aur next morning bhi thoda bacha hota hai. Charging bhi jaldi ho jaati hai. Games nahi khelta, mostly calls aur YouTube. Mere use mein toh koi battery tension nahi hai.

Bought it to record short cooking videos. Still photos of the dishes look good, but in video the focus keeps jumping between my hands and the food. Sometimes half the clip is blurry before it settles. Tapping to lock focus helps. Usable, just more fiddly than I hoped.

After two months the finish around the charging port has started peeling, and one corner of the back panel no longer sits flush with the frame. It's always been in a case. I still like how it looks, but the way it's put together doesn't inspire much confidence. Expected better durability for 25k.
Love the simple blue finish. I have big hands and the wide shape is actually comfortable for me. Buttons are easy to reach too.

Got it for my mother. Increasing the font size hasn't made the text look fuzzy, which is nice, and she finds the screen easy to read. Her usual WhatsApp and banking apps open quickly. She charges it roughly every other day with very light use. She says it feels heavy during long calls, so that's the one downside.
Great, exactly what I needed: another device that lives next to a socket. Down from 100% to 35% in three hours of ordinary browsing. My four-year-old phone lasted longer.

Good: crisp screen, smooth scrolling, firm buttons with no rattling. Bad: night photos are grainy and bright signs turn into white blobs. The photos are fine during the day though. At ₹24,999 the overall package feels fair to me, but I can see why someone buying mainly for night photography would be disappointed.

I read a lot of scanned PDFs on the train. Small lettering looks sharp and I don't need to zoom in as much as on my old phone. White pages look a little too blue on the default setting, but switching to the warmer colour mode sorted that out. Very happy with the screen now.

I sell clothes online and bought this for product pictures. It makes red fabric look orange and keeps brightening darker shades even in daylight. Sent the photos to my laptop to check, so it isn't just how the phone displays them. Having to correct every picture before uploading is a pain.

Was about to spend nearly 40k and then bought this for ₹24,999 instead. After a month I honestly don't feel I've missed out for the things I do. Feels like a sensible purchase and I'm glad I kept the extra money.

Nothing loose or creaky on mine, it feels properly put together. But the sides are so slippery that I keep adjusting my grip, and reaching the opposite corner with one hand is awkward. A bulky case helps the grip and makes the size even worse. Wish I'd held it in a shop first.

I'm playing COD Mobile at medium settings for about an hour each evening. It stays responsive and I haven't noticed the stuttering some people mentioned. It gets warm, but that hasn't affected the game on my unit. These sessions use plenty of charge, as expected, so I top up before bed. Happy with the gaming experience for what I paid.

Main camera on my unit just refuses to focus. Receipts, people, buildings, everything comes out blurred. Cleaned the lens, removed the case and reset the camera app. No difference. The front camera works, but I didn't buy a phone just to take selfies. Returning this unit.

Screen seedha dekho toh colours achhe hain. Thoda side se dekho toh white background green sa lagta hai. Video dekhte time itna notice nahi hota, reading mein hota hai. Mere liye display bas theek thaak hai, bahut impressive nahi.
Only loses about 2% overnight on my Wi-Fi. My old phone used to drop nearly 15%. Nice to wake up without worrying about charging first.
Camera is only okay. Bought it for the bright, colourful screen and that part is fantastic. That's what matters most to me.

Apps open quickly and the display looks great, so the hardware side seems fine. What spoils it for me is all the preinstalled junk and promotional notifications. Spent the first evening disabling things I never asked for. I wanted a clean experience and this feels unnecessarily cluttered.

Changed the refresh rate to the lower setting and now I finish the day without needing a top-up. Scrolling isn't quite as fluid, but I barely notice after a while. At the higher setting the screen feels lovely and smooth, though the extra charging was inconvenient for me. Nice to have the choice.

There is a delay between pressing the shutter and actually taking the picture. Tried to photograph my daughter blowing out her candles and got the moment after she'd finished. Stationary objects look sharp, so the detail is there. It's capturing the right moment that this camera struggles with.

Four months of daily use and it's holding up well. The charging cable still fits snugly, buttons haven't loosened and the frame has no peeling. Doesn't feel delicate at all. I was doubtful about the construction when I ordered, but I've got no complaints now.
The design is pretty boring. Big camera circles and a plain back, just like everything else. Fine if you like that look, I was hoping for something a bit more distinctive.

Backup toh achha mil raha hai, poora din nikal jata hai. Bas charging slow lagti hai. Subah jaldi mein lagao toh utna charge nahi hota jitna chahiye. Raat ko laga ke chhodne walon ko shayad problem na ho, mere routine mein thoda annoying hai.
Regret buying this. Not happy at all.

Went for the 8GB version with the 50 MP camera. Haven't taken any pictures yet. What I have noticed is how quickly it opens big spreadsheets compared with my old phone. Switching between the sheet and my calculator doesn't lose my place either. Good start for my work use.

I mostly photograph handwritten notes and receipts. Even the tiny writing near the edges comes out readable, without me having to take the shot three times. That's all I really need from the camera and it does it very well.

Paid ₹24,999 and then saw it advertised for ₹20,999 two weeks later. The phone itself is okay, but at what I paid I don't think it's good value. The lower price would have made much more sense. Feeling a bit shortchanged.

After three months this has been a dependable daily phone. Messaging and maps are quick, and the screen stays readable on my commute. A whole day on home Wi-Fi is easy; using mobile data and navigation outdoors drains it much faster, so I carry a power bank on trips. The body still feels solid. Slightly too heavy for my liking, but overall I'm satisfied for ₹24,999.
